reconstruction.statement: For any natural n,D, any already-stored sequence of n+1 real D-by-(2D) local core tables, and arbitrary real length-D left/right vectors, ofTable returns a stored dependent real tensor chain of length n+1 with both boundary bonds 1. Its denotation exactly equals the chronological semantic boundary assembly whenever those finite tables match K on start,...,start+n. Its own synthetic charged operation total is at most 20D^2+30D+5n^2+7n+31 unconditionally. Its maximum bond is at most max(D,1) under the stated Window binder.
reconstruction.coefficient_formula: For word (bit_0,...,bit_n), scalar coefficient = left^T K(start,bit_0) K(start+1,bit_1) ... K(start+n,bit_n) right. No conjugation, sign removal, normalization, approximation, or reversed matrix order.

ambient.stored_core: Vector (Vector Real (2*r)) l; flatten (bit,b) via finProdFinEquiv, index bit*r+b
ambient.chain: Dependent inductive StoredChain n l r; nil r denotes identity at terminal bond r; cons changes n to n+1 and carries compatible intermediate bond
ambient.word: Word 0=Unit; Word(n+1)=Fin2 x Word n; first head emits first bit
ambient.length: Always n+1 >=1; zero-site ofTable is not defined. Zero D and zero r in initial are permitted; some Fin-index entry interfaces have empty domains then.
ambient.maxBond: nil r maps to r; cons with left l maps to max l (maxBond tail), includes scalar endpoints
ambient.kernel: Nat -> Fin2 -> Matrix(FinD)(FinD) Real; only a specification argument, not a production callback

declarations.name: QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredMatrixProductChain.tailChain
declarations.mathematics: Input has n+1 stored cores. n=0: read the last table, terminal-contract right, allocate cons and nil (two node budgets). n>0: read/share the first core, copy the remaining vector of references, recursively close the right boundary, allocate one cons.
declarations.exact_source_signature:
noncomputable def tailChain {D : ℕ} : {n : ℕ} →
    Vector (StoredCore D D) (n + 1) → Vector ℝ D → Run (StoredChain (n + 1) D 1)
  | 0, tables, right => do
      let A ← read tables 0
      let B ← terminal A right
      (⟨.cons B (.nil 1), 2 • nodeBudget⟩ : Run _)
  | _n + 1, tables, right => do
      let A ← read tables 0
      let ts ← tailTable tables
      let C ← tailChain ts right
      (⟨.cons A C, nodeBudget⟩ : Run _)

declarations.name: QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredMatrixProductChain.tailChain_value
declarations.mathematics: Given Window, equality of whole denoted returned dependent chain to the chronological semantic tailChain K right start n, not just coefficient equivalence.
declarations.exact_source_signature:
theorem tailChain_value {n D : ℕ} (tables : Vector (StoredCore D D) (n + 1))
    (right : Vector ℝ D) (K : MatrixProductChain.Kernel D) (start : ℕ)
    (h : Window tables K start) :
    denoteChain (tailChain tables right).value =
      MatrixProductChain.tailChain K (fun i => right[i.val]) start n
declarations.exact_source_declaration:
theorem tailChain_value {n D : ℕ} (tables : Vector (StoredCore D D) (n + 1))
    (right : Vector ℝ D) (K : MatrixProductChain.Kernel D) (start : ℕ)
    (h : Window tables K start) :
    denoteChain (tailChain tables right).value =
      MatrixProductChain.tailChain K (fun i => right[i.val]) start n := by
  induction n generalizing start with
  | zero =>
      simp only [tailChain, bind, Run.bind, StoredGivens.read, charge, denoteChain,
        terminal_value, MatrixProductChain.tailChain]
      have h0 := h 0
      simp only [Fin.val_zero, Nat.add_zero] at h0
      simp only [Fin.val_zero]
      rw [h0]
      rfl
  | succ n ih =>
      simp only [tailChain, bind, Run.bind, StoredGivens.read, charge, denoteChain,
        MatrixProductChain.tailChain]
      have h0 := h 0
      simp only [Fin.val_zero, Nat.add_zero] at h0
      simp only [Fin.val_zero]
      rw [h0, ih (tailTable tables).value (start + 1)]
      intro i
      rw [tailTable_value, h i.succ]
      simp [Fin.val_succ, Nat.add_comm, Nat.add_left_comm] <;> rfl

  (h : QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredMatrixProductChain.Window tables K start) :
